"""Job 10 (CPU): one read-only pass over the 1137 out-of-fold cases.   scan.py

Per case, with M's probabilities from the fold that did not train on it:
- gates: package manifest, versions, r5 pins, r2 pins, exactly the folds' cases, no locked104 case (ID list only);
- checks: D0 of the npz equals M's exported label map; D2 -> small4vox -> edema_only computed here equals the
  prediction of r2's arm D2__B2 voxel for voxel (file SHA256 from r2's DECODE.csv), so everything below refers to
  the arm whose official scores r2 recorded;
- CASES.csv: cohort, header features of the label and T1n files (item 3), label counts after and before the
  organisers' revision, predicted cavity voxels per decoding, reference tissue intensities;
- CAVITIES.csv: one row per reference cavity (items 1 and 5, rca.cavity_rows);
- QUANT.csv: size and decoding differences of two 8-bit encodings of the probabilities (item 6).
Reads images and labels of the training pool only. Writes only under results/scan/A<n>/.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import os
import time
import traceback
from multiprocessing import Pool
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict

import numpy as np

import common as C
import p4arm as PA
import p4ops as P
import p4pipe as PP
import p4prior as PR
import rca as RC

RUN = RC.RUN


def scan_case(task) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    import nibabel as nib

    k, case, m_dir, meta, paths, b2_path, b2_sha = task
    start = time.time()
    ref_img = nib.load(paths["label"])
    ref = np.asanyarray(ref_img.dataobj)
    old = np.asanyarray(nib.load(paths["old_label"]).dataobj)
    for name, data in (("label", ref), ("old label", old)):
        C.require(np.array_equal(data, np.round(data)) and data.min() >= 0 and data.max() <= 4, f"{case}: {name} is not 0-4")
    ref, old = ref.astype(np.uint8), old.astype(np.uint8)
    C.require(old.shape == ref.shape, f"{case}: old label shape {old.shape} vs {ref.shape}")
    p = PP.load_probabilities(str(Path(m_dir) / f"{case}.npz"))
    C.require(p.shape[1:] == ref.shape, f"{case}: probabilities {p.shape} vs label {ref.shape}")
    exported = np.asanyarray(nib.load(str(Path(m_dir) / f"{case}.nii.gz")).dataobj)
    d0 = P.decode_d0(p)
    C.require(int(np.count_nonzero(d0 != exported)) == 0, f"{case}: D0 differs from the exported label map")
    spacing = tuple(float(z) for z in ref_img.header.get_zooms()[:3])
    voxel = float(np.prod(spacing))
    d2 = P.decode_d2(p)
    b2 = RC.b2_tail(d2, voxel)
    C.require(C.sha256_file(Path(b2_path)) == b2_sha, f"{case}: r2 D2__B2 prediction differs from its DECODE.csv")
    theirs = np.asanyarray(nib.load(b2_path).dataobj)
    C.require(theirs.shape == b2.shape and int(np.count_nonzero(theirs != b2)) == 0, f"{case}: B2 here differs from r2's D2__B2")
    image_files = [nib.load(f) for f in paths["images"]]
    images = [np.asanyarray(img.dataobj).astype(np.float32) for img in image_files]
    C.require(all(x.shape == ref.shape for x in images), f"{case}: image shape differs from the label")

    row: Dict[str, Any] = dict(fold=k, nnunet_case_id=case, **meta)
    row.update(RC.header_features(ref_img, "hdr_label"))
    row.update(RC.header_features(image_files[0], "hdr_t1n"))
    row["images_share_label_affine"] = bool(all(np.allclose(img.affine, ref_img.affine, atol=1e-4) for img in image_files))
    row["image_dtypes"] = "/".join(str(img.header.get_data_dtype()) for img in image_files)
    for tag, data in (("ref", ref), ("old", old)):
        counts = np.bincount(data.ravel(), minlength=5)
        row.update({f"{tag}_label{v}": int(counts[v]) for v in range(1, 5)})
    row["label_changed"] = bool(not np.array_equal(ref, old))
    row["rc_label_changed"] = bool(not np.array_equal(ref == P.RC_L, old == P.RC_L))
    for tag, seg in (("d0", d0), ("d2", d2), ("b2", b2)):
        row[f"{tag}_rc_voxels"] = int((seg == P.RC_L).sum())
    row["false_rc_b2"] = bool(row["ref_label4"] == 0 and row["b2_rc_voxels"] > 0)

    exclude = (ref > 0) | (old > 0) | (b2 > 0) | (d0 > 0)
    csf = RC.csf_proxy(images, exclude)
    row["csf_proxy_voxels"] = int(csf.sum()) if csf is not None else 0
    brain = images[0] > 0
    for j, mod in enumerate(RC.MODALITIES):
        row[f"{mod}_brain_median"] = RC.median_or_none(images[j], brain)
        row[f"{mod}_csf_median"] = RC.median_or_none(images[j], csf)
        for name, value in (("netc", P.NETC_L), ("snfh", P.SNFH_L), ("et", P.ET_L)):
            row[f"{mod}_{name}_median"] = RC.median_or_none(images[j], ref == value)

    cavities = RC.cavity_rows(ref, old, p, {"d0": d0, "d2": d2, "b2": b2}, images, spacing, csf)
    row["cavities"] = len(cavities)
    row["large_cavities"] = sum(c["large"] for c in cavities)
    row["large_cavities_matched"] = sum(c["large"] and c["match_dice"] > 0 for c in cavities)
    head = {"fold": k, "nnunet_case_id": case, "source_case_id": meta["source_case_id"],
            "patient_group": meta["patient_group"], "label_changed": row["label_changed"],
            "rc_label_changed": row["rc_label_changed"]}
    quant = dict(fold=k, nnunet_case_id=case,
                 **RC.quantisation_row(p, d0, d2, (Path(m_dir) / f"{case}.npz").stat().st_size))
    row["seconds"] = round(time.time() - start, 1)
    return {"case": row, "cavities": [dict(head, **c) for c in cavities], "quant": quant}


def workers() -> int:
    return max(1, int(os.environ.get("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", "4")) - 1)


def main() -> None:
    attempt = RC.attempts("SCAN")
    tag = f"SCAN_A{attempt}"
    record: Dict[str, Any] = {"attempt": attempt}
    C.evidence(f"{tag}_STARTED.json", "started", attempt=attempt)
    try:
        record["manifest_sha256"] = C.verify_manifest()
        record["versions"] = PA.check_versions()
        record["prior_manifest_sha256"] = PR.manifest()
        cases, dirs, members, ids = PA.cases_and_dirs(["M"])
        record["members"] = members
        table = RC.case_table()
        name = RUN["scan"]["baseline_arm"]
        prior = PR.record(name)
        prior_out = Path(prior["output_dir"])
        C.require(C.sha256_file(prior_out / "DECODE.csv") == prior["decode_csv_sha256"], f"r2 {name}: DECODE.csv drift")
        with (prior_out / "DECODE.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
            shas = {r["nnunet_case_id"]: r["sha256"] for r in csv.DictReader(handle)}
        C.require(sorted(shas) == sorted(c for _, c in cases), f"r2 {name}: DECODE.csv cases differ from the folds")
        out = C.ROOT / "results" / "scan" / f"A{attempt}"
        C.require(not out.exists(), f"{out} exists")
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
        tasks = [(k, c, str(dirs[("M", k)]), table[c], RC.case_paths(c), str(prior_out / "pred" / f"{c}.nii.gz"), shas[c])
                 for k, c in cases]
        started = time.time()
        with Pool(workers()) as pool:
            results = list(pool.imap(scan_case, tasks, chunksize=2))
        case_rows = [r["case"] for r in results]
        cavity_rows = [c for r in results for c in r["cavities"]]
        quant_rows = [r["quant"] for r in results]
        C.write_csv(out / "CASES.csv", case_rows)
        C.write_csv(out / "CAVITIES.csv", cavity_rows)
        C.write_csv(out / "QUANT.csv", quant_rows)
        record.update(output_dir=str(out), cases=len(case_rows), cavities=len(cavity_rows),
                      large_cavities=sum(bool(c["large"]) for c in cavity_rows),
                      rc_cases=sum(r["ref_label4"] > 0 for r in case_rows),
                      cases_csv_sha256=C.sha256_file(out / "CASES.csv"),
                      cavities_csv_sha256=C.sha256_file(out / "CAVITIES.csv"),
                      quant_csv_sha256=C.sha256_file(out / "QUANT.csv"),
                      baseline_arm=name, baseline_equals_r2=True, seconds=round(time.time() - started, 1),
                      workers=workers())
        C.evidence(f"{tag}_COMPLETE.json", "pass", **record)
        print(f"scan pass: attempt {attempt}, {len(case_rows)} cases, {len(cavity_rows)} cavities")
    except Exception as error:
        record.update(error=repr(error), traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        C.evidence(f"{tag}_FAILED.json", "failed", **record)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Shared pieces of the RC audit package (read-only analyses; numpy + scipy, unit-tested locally).

- cohorts and file paths of a case (labels after and before the organisers' revision, the four images);
- header features of a NIfTI file (item 3: can the data source be told from the header alone);
- per-cavity measurements (items 1 and 5);
- a CSF proxy for intensity ratios (item 5);
- two 8-bit encodings of the probabilities and decoding from them (item 6);
- the three inference-side variants (item 2);
- evidence helpers.
Nothing here writes outside this package, and no locked104 image or label is opened.
"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cases

def cohort(row: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """UCSD or the Training root cohort, from the T1n source path (rule of s2_rc_sri24_labelcheck_20261101_r1).
    The data source of a case is known at inference time; no label is read for it."""
    return "UCSD" if "/UCSD - Training/" in row["t1n_source_path"] else "Training_root"


def case_table() -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    """nnU-Net case ID -> BraTS ID, patient, cohort and T2W status, from the pinned mapping CSV."""
    path = Path(RUN["mapping"]["path"])
    C.require(C.sha256_file(path) == RUN["mapping"]["sha256"], "case mapping CSV differs from its pin")
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
    return {r["nnunet_case_id"]: {"source_case_id": r["source_case_id"], "patient_group": r["patient_group"],
                                  "cohort": cohort(r), "t2w_status": r["t2w_status"]} for r in rows}


def case_paths(case: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    tree = O.TREE
    return {"label": str(tree / RUN["reference"]["labels_dir"] / f"{case}.nii.gz"),
            "old_label": str(tree / RUN["old_labels"]["labels_dir"] / f"{case}.nii.gz"),
            "images": [str(tree / RUN["images"]["dir"] / f"{case}_{i:04d}.nii.gz") for i in range(len(MODALITIES))]}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- item 3: header features

def header_features(img, prefix: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Geometry and bookkeeping fields of a NIfTI header; no voxel is read."""
    import nibabel as nib

    h = img.header
    zooms = [float(z) for z in h.get_zooms()[:3]]
    affine = img.affine
    text = h["descrip"].tobytes().split(b"\x00")[0].decode("latin-1", "replace").strip()
    slope, inter = h["scl_slope"], h["scl_inter"]
    out = {
        "shape": "x".join(str(int(s)) for s in img.shape[:3]),
        "zooms": "x".join(f"{z:.4f}" for z in zooms),
        "axcodes": "".join(nib.aff2axcodes(affine)),
        "qform_code": int(h["qform_code"]), "sform_code": int(h["sform_code"]),
        "det_sign": int(np.sign(np.linalg.det(affine[:3, :3]))),
        "origin": ",".join(f"{v:.2f}" for v in affine[:3, 3]),
        "dtype": str(h.get_data_dtype()), "bitpix": int(h["bitpix"]),
        "scl_slope": "" if not np.isfinite(slope) else f"{float(slope):g}",
        "scl_inter": "" if not np.isfinite(inter) else f"{float(inter):g}",
        "xyzt_units": int(h["xyzt_units"]), "qfac": float(h["pixdim"][0]),
        "descrip": text[:60], "sizeof_hdr": int(h["sizeof_hdr"]),
        "magic": h["magic"].tobytes().split(b"\x00")[0].decode("latin-1", "replace"),
        "is_sri24": bool(P.is_sri24(img.shape[:3], zooms)),
    }
    return {f"{prefix}_{k}": v for k, v in out.items()}


def separability(rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], features: Sequence[str], target: str = "cohort") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Group the cases by the tuple of the given features; a rule that assigns every group to its majority cohort
    is the best any header-only rule on these features can do. Returns its accuracy and the mixed groups."""
    groups: Dict[Tuple, Dict[str, int]] = {}
    for r in rows:
        key = tuple(str(r[f]) for f in features)
        groups.setdefault(key, {})
        groups[key][r[target]] = groups[key].get(r[target], 0) + 1
    correct = sum(max(g.values()) for g in groups.values())
    mixed = {k: g for k, g in groups.items() if len(g) > 1}
    return {"features": list(features), "groups": len(groups), "accuracy": correct / max(len(rows), 1),
            "misassigned": len(rows) - correct, "mixed_groups": len(mixed),
            "cases_in_mixed_groups": sum(sum(g.values()) for g in mixed.values()),
            "largest_mixed_groups": [{"values": list(k), "counts": g} for k, g in
                                     sorted(mixed.items(), key=lambda kv: -sum(kv[1].values()))[:5]]}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- item 5: a CSF proxy

def robust_z(x: np.ndarray, mask: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    values = x[mask]
    med = float(np.median(values))
    mad = float(np.median(np.abs(values - med))) * 1.4826
    return (x - med) / (mad if mad > 0 else 1.0)


def csf_proxy(images: Sequence[np.ndarray], exclude: np.ndarray, min_voxels: int = 200) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
    """Voxels that look like CSF, without any segmentation of the ventricles: inside the brain, bright on T2W
    (robust z > 1.5), dark on FLAIR and on T1 (z < -0.5), outside every lesion label and prediction, eroded once.
    None when fewer than min_voxels remain. A heuristic for intensity ratios only."""
    from scipy import ndimage

    t1n, _, t2w, t2f = images
    brain = (t1n > 0) & (t2w > 0) & (t2f > 0)
    if int(brain.sum()) < 1000:
        return None
    mask = brain & (robust_z(t2w, brain) > 1.5) & (robust_z(t2f, brain) < -0.5) & (robust_z(t1n, brain) < -0.5) & ~exclude
    mask = ndimage.binary_erosion(mask)
    return mask if int(mask.sum()) >= min_voxels else None


def median_or_none(x: np.ndarray, mask: Optional[np.ndarray]) -> Optional[float]:
    if mask is None or not mask.any():
        return None
    return float(np.median(x[mask]))


def ratio(a: Optional[float], b: Optional[float]) -> Optional[float]:
    return None if a is None or b is None or b == 0 else float(a / b)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- items 1 and 5: one reference cavity

def fractions(values: np.ndarray, n_labels: int = 5) -> List[float]:
    counts = np.bincount(values.astype(np.int64).ravel(), minlength=n_labels)[:n_labels]
    return [float(c) / max(int(values.size), 1) for c in counts]


def cavity_rows(ref: np.ndarray, old: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, segs: Dict[str, np.ndarray],
                images: Sequence[np.ndarray], spacing: Sequence[float], csf: Optional[np.ndarray]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """One row per reference cavity (26-connected component of label 4): size, shape and position; the labels it
    had before the revision; the model's probabilities inside it; what each decoding put there; its match among
    the predicted cavities of the baseline decoding (official-style bipartite matching on Dice); the labels and
    the brain edge around it; its intensities against CSF, the brain and the case's own necrosis."""
    from scipy import ndimage

    voxel = float(np.prod(spacing))
    comps, n = label(ref == P.RC_L)
    if n == 0:
        return []
    base = segs[RUN["scan"]["match_decoding"]]
    pred, n_pred = label(base == P.RC_L)
    overlap, ref_size, pred_size = overlap_table(comps, n, pred, n_pred)
    matches = {r: (c, d) for r, c, d in bipartite_match(overlap, ref_size, pred_size)} if n_pred else {}
    brain = images[0] > 0
    brain_median = [median_or_none(x, brain) for x in images]
    csf_median = [median_or_none(x, csf) for x in images]
    netc_median = [median_or_none(x, ref == P.NETC_L) for x in images]
    boxes = ndimage.find_objects(comps)
    rows = []
    for i in range(n):
        pad = tuple(slice(max(s.start - 3, 0), min(s.stop + 3, dim)) for s, dim in zip(boxes[i], ref.shape))
        m = comps[pad] == i + 1
        full = np.zeros(ref.shape, dtype=bool)
        full[pad] = m
        size = int(ref_size[i])
        coords = np.argwhere(m) + np.array([s.start for s in pad])
        centroid = coords.mean(axis=0)
        extent = coords.max(axis=0) - coords.min(axis=0) + 1
        shell = ndimage.binary_dilation(m, structure=np.ones((3, 3, 3), bool), iterations=2) & ~m
        row: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "cavity": i + 1, "voxels": size, "volume_mm3": size * voxel, "large": bool(size * voxel >= LARGE_MM3),
            "extent_x": int(extent[0]), "extent_y": int(extent[1]), "extent_z": int(extent[2]),
            "fill_of_box": size / float(np.prod(extent)),
            "surface_fraction": float((m & ~ndimage.binary_erosion(m)).sum()) / size,
            "centroid_x": float(centroid[0]), "centroid_y": float(centroid[1]), "centroid_z": float(centroid[2]),
            "centroid_fx": float(centroid[0] / ref.shape[0]), "centroid_fy": float(centroid[1] / ref.shape[1]),
            "centroid_fz": float(centroid[2] / ref.shape[2]),
        }
        for v, f in enumerate(fractions(old[pad][m])):
            row[f"old_label{v}"] = f
        for c, name in enumerate(P.CHANNELS):
            values = p[c][pad][m]
            row[f"p_{name}_mean"], row[f"p_{name}_max"] = float(values.mean()), float(values.max())
            row[f"p_{name}_over_050"] = float((values > 0.5).mean())
        rc = p[P.RC][pad][m]
        row["p_rc_over_025"], row["p_rc_over_010"] = float((rc >= 0.25).mean()), float((rc >= 0.10).mean())
        row["netc_score_mean"] = float(np.clip(p[P.TC][pad][m] - p[P.ET][pad][m], 0.0, 1.0).mean())
        for key, seg in segs.items():
            for v, f in enumerate(fractions(seg[pad][m])):
                row[f"{key}_label{v}"] = f
        match = matches.get(i)
        inter = int(overlap[i].sum()) if n_pred else 0
        row["covered_by_predicted_rc"] = inter / size
        row["match_dice"] = float(match[1]) if match else 0.0
        row["match_pred_voxels"] = int(pred_size[match[0]]) if match else 0
        if match:
            both = float(overlap[i, match[0]])
            row["match_iou"] = both / (size + float(pred_size[match[0]]) - both)
        else:
            row["match_iou"] = 0.0
        for v, f in enumerate(fractions(ref[pad][shell])):
            row[f"shell_label{v}"] = f
        row["shell_outside_brain"] = float((~brain[pad][shell]).mean()) if shell.any() else None
        for j, mod in enumerate(MODALITIES):
            x = images[j]
            inside = float(np.median(x[pad][m]))
            row[f"{mod}_median"] = inside
            row[f"{mod}_iqr"] = float(np.subtract(*np.percentile(x[pad][m], (75, 25))))
            row[f"{mod}_over_csf"] = ratio(inside, csf_median[j])
            row[f"{mod}_over_brain"] = ratio(inside, brain_median[j])
            row[f"{mod}_over_netc"] = ratio(inside, netc_median[j])
        rows.append(row)
    return rows


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- item 6: 8-bit encodings

GRID = 100  # code B: a 0.01 grid, on which every threshold of D0, D2 and W lies


def encode_plain(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Code A: round(p * 255)."""
    return np.rint(p.astype(np.float64) * 255.0).astype(np.uint8)


def encode_grid(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Code B: q = 2 * floor(100 p) + (1 if 100 p is not an integer). Even codes are exact grid values, so for a
    threshold t on the grid: p > t <=> q > 200 t and p >= t <=> q >= 200 t. Values 0..200 fit 8 bits."""
    x = p.astype(np.float64) * GRID
    f = np.floor(x)
    return (2.0 * f + (x != f)).astype(np.uint8)


def decode_grid_d0(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    return P.compose([q[c] > 100 for c in range(4)])


def decode_grid_d2(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    f = q.astype(np.float32)
    return P.compose([P.kcl_hyst(f[P.WT], 50, 140), P.kcl_hyst(f[P.TC], 50, 140), P.kcl_hyst(f[P.ET], 50, 140),
                      q[P.RC] >= 100])


def quantisation_row(p: np.ndarray, d0: np.ndarray, d2: np.ndarray, npz_bytes: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    a, b = encode_plain(p), encode_grid(p)
    pa = a.astype(np.float32) / np.float32(255.0)
    return {
        "npz_bytes": int(npz_bytes),
        "plain_zlib_bytes": len(zlib.compress(a.tobytes(), 6)),
        "grid_zlib_bytes": len(zlib.compress(b.tobytes(), 6)),
        "plain_d0_differ_voxels": int(np.count_nonzero(P.decode_d0(pa) != d0)),
        "plain_d2_differ_voxels": int(np.count_nonzero(P.decode_d2(pa) != d2)),
        "grid_d0_differ_voxels": int(np.count_nonzero(decode_grid_d0(b) != d0)),
        "grid_d2_differ_voxels": int(np.count_nonzero(decode_grid_d2(b) != d2)),
        "plain_max_abs_error": float(np.abs(pa - p).max()),
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- item 2: inference-side variants

def b2_tail(seg: np.ndarray, voxel: float) -> np.ndarray:
    """small4vox then edema_only, the two steps that make B2 out of a decoding (P4 addendum section 2)."""
    seg, _ = R.remove_small(seg, (1, 2, 3, 4), voxel, min_voxels=4)
    seg, _ = remove_edema_only(seg)
    return seg


def baseline_b2(p: np.ndarray, voxel: float) -> np.ndarray:
    return b2_tail(P.decode_d2(p), voxel)


def variant_decode(spec: Dict[str, Any], p: np.ndarray, case_cohort: str, voxel: float) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, Dict[str, Any]]:
    """One variant on one case: a changed D2, then the B2 tail. Returns the label map and what the variant did."""
    kind = spec["kind"]
    hyst = [P.kcl_hyst(p[c], 0.25, 0.70) for c in (P.WT, P.TC, P.ET)]
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if kind == "rc_threshold":
        rc = p[P.RC] >= float(spec["threshold"])
        stats["rc_voxels_added"] = int(rc.sum() - (p[P.RC] >= 0.5).sum())
        seg = P.compose(hyst + [rc])
    elif kind == "rc_off_outside_ucsd":
        off = case_cohort != "UCSD"
        rc = np.zeros(p[P.RC].shape, bool) if off else p[P.RC] >= 0.5
        stats["rc_switched_off"] = bool(off)
        stats["rc_voxels_removed"] = int((p[P.RC] >= 0.5).sum()) if off else 0
        seg = P.compose(hyst + [rc])
    elif kind == "rc_netc_vote":
        seg = P.decode_d2(p)
        union = (seg == P.RC_L) | (seg == P.NETC_L)
        comps, n = label(union)
        to_rc = to_netc = 0
        if n:
            index = np.arange(1, n + 1)
            from scipy import ndimage

            rc_score = ndimage.mean(p[P.RC], comps, index)
            netc_score = ndimage.mean(np.clip(p[P.TC] - p[P.ET], 0.0, 1.0), comps, index)
            target = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.uint8)
            target[1:] = np.where(np.asarray(rc_score) > np.asarray(netc_score), P.RC_L, P.NETC_L)
            new = target[comps]
            to_rc = int(((new == P.RC_L) & (seg == P.NETC_L)).sum())
            to_netc = int(((new == P.NETC_L) & (seg == P.RC_L)).sum())
            seg = np.where(union, new, seg).astype(np.uint8)
        stats.update(components=int(n), voxels_netc_to_rc=to_rc, voxels_rc_to_netc=to_netc)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown variant kind {kind}")
    return b2_tail(seg, voxel).astype(np.uint8, copy=False), stats


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- this package's evidence

def attempts(prefix: str) -> int:
    n = 0
    while (EVIDENCE / f"{prefix}_A{n}_STARTED.json").exists():
        n += 1
    return n


def latest_pass(prefix: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    for n in reversed(range(attempts(prefix))):
        path = EVIDENCE / f"{prefix}_A{n}_COMPLETE.json"
        if path.exists():
            record = C.read_json(path)
            if record["status"] == "pass":
                return record
    return None
